create_geoplotter_figure: create a GeoPlotter instance with a specified zoom level for interactive map visualization
plot_points_on_map: plot latitude and longitude points as colored markers on an OpenStreetMap using GeoPlotter
draw_bbox_on_map: draw a bounding box outline on the map using GeoPlotter with a specified color
apply_colormap_to_rasters: apply the Colormap class to colorize area and way rasters using map category colors
plot_nodes_on_raster: plot node locations from a raster array as labeled scatter points on a matplotlib axis
